CharacterDossier.title: CharacterDossier
CharacterDossier.description: A tabletop RPG character sheet owned by an authenticated player.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the character owner.

ownerName.description: Display name of the player who owns this character.

gameSystem.description: Identifier of the RPG system (e.g., delta-green).

sessionId.description: Optional ID of the Game Master session this character is assigned to.

sessionGmId.description: Optional Firebase Auth UID of the Game Master whose session this character joined.

fullNameAndAlias.description: Agent last name, first name, and alias or code name.

ageAndDob.description: Agent age and date of birth.

portraitUrl.description: URL or compressed data URI for character portrait.

firstAidAttempted.description: Whether First Aid has been attempted since the last injury.

developmentsHomeAndFamily.description: Developments which affect home and family.

recruitmentNote.description: Why the agent was recruited and agreed to join.

sheetData.description: Structured native map containing statistics, derived attributes, adaptation, bonds, skills, weapons, and specialTraining.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the character was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the character was last updated.

GmAsset.title: GmAsset
GmAsset.description: A reusable Game Master asset (NPC card, Location card, Archive Image, or Styled Document) stored in the GM's database.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Game Master who owns this asset.

gameSystem.description: Identifier of the RPG system (e.g., delta-green).

title.description: Title or name of the NPC, Location, Image, or Document.

subtitle.description: Role, affiliation, coordinates, exhibit code, or document header.

imageUrl.description: Optional image URL or data URI for the NPC portrait, location photo, or archive image.

publicContent.description: Public description or document text visible to players when shared.

gmSecretNotes.description: Private GM notes, hidden clues, or NPC combat stats never shown to players.

docStyle.description: Visual style preset when category is document.

docFont.description: Typography preset when category is document.

docSignature.description: Optional signature, stamp, or footer text on a document.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the asset was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the asset was last updated.

GameSession.title: GameSession
GameSession.description: A live tabletop RPG session hosted by a Game Master with invited players.

gmId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Game Master.

gmName.description: Display name of the Game Master.

gmEmail.description: Email address of the Game Master.

gameSystem.description: Identifier of the RPG system (e.g., delta-green).

invitedEmails.description: List of lowercase Gmail addresses invited to join this session (max 20).

joinedPlayers.description: List of player objects who have joined and linked a character (max 20).

sceneState.description: Current scene title, location, in-game date/time, and alert level.

spotlightItem.description: Currently spotlighted handout item shown prominently to all players.

sharedItems.description: History of NPCs, Locations, Images, and Styled Documents shared with players in this session.

publicRolls.description: Public dice rolls and announcements broadcast to the table.

privateRolls.description: Private GM dice rolls visible only to the Game Master.

combatTracker.description: Initiative and combat turn tracker entries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was last updated.

/characters/{characterId}.description: Stores RPG character sheets owned by individual authenticated users and optionally linked to a GM session.

/gmAssets/{assetId}.description: Stores reusable Game Master NPC cards, Location cards, Archive Images, and Styled Documents.

/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores live Game Master sessions with invited player emails, shared handouts, and tabletop tools.
